newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez Lyonnaise to retain key financial assets.
newsitem.headline: Suez Lyonnaise to retain key financial assets.

text.p: Cie de Suez chairman Gerard Mestrallet said on Friday that the newly merged Suez Lyonnaise des Eaux would hold on to Suez's main assets in the financial sector, Generale de Banque, Fortis AMEV.AS and Sofinco.

"As well as Sofinco, Generale de Banque and Fortis have their place in the group. I am convinced that because of their contribution to profit and the possibility of creating future value ... they will hold their place in the new group for a long time," he said.
Suez Lyonnaise des Eaux is the group resulting from a merger of Cie de Suez and Lyonnaise des Eaux announced earlier on Friday.
